# Paul Cézanne — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Paul Cézanne known for?", "Mont Sainte-Victoire"),
    ("What field did Paul Cézanne work in?", "Post-Impressionism"),
    ("What is lived?", "1839-1906"),
    ("What is field?", "Post-Impressionism"),
    ("What is known for?", "Mont Sainte-Victoire"),
    ("What is note?", "Father of modern art"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
